name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with engines alongside his grandfather, a former mechanic. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and quickly found his way into the racing world. He started as a junior engineer, meticulously analyzing data and contributing to vehicle setup. 

Maximilian's approach as a technical director centers around a collaborative environment where innovative ideas are nurtured. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. While still developing his managerial skills, his dedication and analytical mindset are quickly making him a rising star in the field. He is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance through data-driven insights and a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side
physical.description: Maximilian has a lean build and a focused look about him.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work standing up whenever possible.
